title: Best Spokesperson Video Creators (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a spokesperson or presenter for your video: what to include, scripts, usage rights, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: A spokesperson video features a presenter speaking directly to camera about your product, service or message. It adds a human face to websites, ads, training and announcements. Orders go wrong when the script is too long or stiff, usage rights are unclear, or the presenter's delivery does not fit your brand. This guide helps you get a presenter video that sounds natural and can be used where you need it.

faq.a: Usually you, or a scriptwriter. Some presenters offer script help. Read it aloud and time it before sending.

faq.q: Where can I use the video?
faq.a: Only where the license allows. Website, social media, paid ads and TV can require different rights. Agree on all uses in writing.

faq.q: Can the presenter read in another language?
faq.a: Many presenters work in several languages or accents. Ask for a sample in the language and accent you need.
Sometimes. Some presenters deliver raw footage; others add background, captions and graphics. Check what you will receive.
Some services offer AI-generated presenters. Be clear with viewers where required, and check platform and advertising rules.
